risk_if_not_implemented: Without Temperature & Humidity Controls Alerting, unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), Physical / Environmental Damage (R-SF-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-10, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; man-made threats MT-7, MT-9, MT-10, MT-12, MT-23, MT-27.

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Monitoring with Alarms / Notifications (PES-29.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Temperature & Humidity Controls Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Facility security mechanisms exist to maintain and monitor temperature and humidity levels within the facility.
compensating_control_2.justification: Temperature & Humidity Controls Monitoring (PES-29) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Monitoring with Alarms / Notifications (PES-29.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
